title: Hearty Filipino Rice Pilaf
description: A comforting Filipino dish featuring Thai bird chili and tempering chocolate, served on a hot stone plate. This low-fat friendly pilaf is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat a large saucepan over medium heat and add the diced grass-fed beef.
Cook the beef until browned, then set aside.
In the same saucepan, add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped Thai bird chili and cook for another minute.
Add the uncooked white rice and stir to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Add the water, low-fat coconut milk, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the rice pilaf with a fork and stir in the tempering chocolate.
Serve the Hearty Filipino Rice Pilaf on a hot stone plate and top with the cooked grass-fed beef.
